creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Accepting Codex's own "Update now" prompt handed the pane to `brew upgrade --cask codex`, a download of minutes. 23 s in, @muster told the maker the helper "went idle without posting ... its turn may have ended on an error", and `pane wait --until idle` returned. The pane was busy.

Treat a pane whose foreground process is not the agent as busy, or say in the notice that the agent's process is gone and something else is running. From tooling feedback a_2ynYuxbg6.
title: A pane reads idle while Codex's self-update runs brew in it
